description: This PHP source file is part of the vTiger CRM system. It initializes and assigns variables to a Smarty template for editing a mail scanner rule, including loading related information about the scanner and rule objects, and rendering the 'MailScanner/MailScannerRuleEdit.tpl' template.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a mail scanner, with a method to retrieve its properties as a map.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerRule
classes.description: Represents a mail scanner rule, initialized via its ID.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty templating object specialized for vTiger CRM.

methods.name: getAsMap
methods.description: Returns the mail scanner info as an associative array.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Loads the language strings for a specified module in a specific language.
